lines: Stringed instruments' long tones, ordered resonance:
undivided mind at limit — supreme-sky body.
sanskrit_cite: tantryādivādyaśabdeṣu dīrgheṣu kramasaṃsthiteḥ | ananyacetāḥ pratyante paravyomavapur bhavet

lines: Body-mantra's gross course, ending moon-drop-sound:
void uttering — one may become Śiva.
sanskrit_cite: pi.ṅdamantrasya sarvasya sthūlavarṇakrameṇa tu | ardhendubindunādāntaḥ śūnyoccārād bhavec chivaḥ

lines: In own body all directions at once as sky:
undirected mind — of him sky proceeds all through.
sanskrit_cite: nijadehe sarvadikkaṃ yugapad bhāvayed viyat | nirvikalpamanās tasya viyat sarvam pravartate

lines: Back-void, root-void at once contemplated, who so —
by body-disregarding power, void-minded may be.
sanskrit_cite: pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ yugapad bhāvayec ca yaḥ | śarīranirapekṣiṇyā śaktyā śūnyamanā bhavet

lines: Back, root, heart voids steady contemplated:
at once from thoughtlessness — thoughtless-rising then.
sanskrit_cite: pṛṣṭaśūnyaṃ mūlaśūnyaṃ hṛcchūnyam bhāvayet sthiram | yugapan nirvikalpatvān nirvikalpodayas tataḥ

lines: On body-place voidness indeed, mere moment:
thoughtless, thoughtless — sharing thoughtless nature.
sanskrit_cite: tanūdeśe śūnyataiva kṣaṇamātraṃ vibhāvayet | nirvikalpaṃ nirvikalpo nirvikalpasvarūpabhāk

lines: All gone in body-stuff, sky-pervaded, deer-eyed:
envisioned then — of him contemplation steadies.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ dehagataṃ dravyaṃ viyadvyāptaṃ mṛgekṣaṇe | vibhāvayet tatas tasya bhāvanā sā sthirā bhavet

lines: Inside body, skin-division wall-like think through:
nothing inside — unmeditated-sharer may be.
sanskrit_cite: dehāntare tvagvibhāgam bhittibhūtaṃ vicintayet | na kiṃcid antare tasya dhyāyann adhyeyabhāg bhavet

lines: In heart-sky, eyes hidden, mid lotus-casket gone:
undivided-minded, fortunate — supreme fortune won.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdyākāśe nilīnākṣaḥ padmasampuṭamadhyagaḥ | ananyacetāḥ subhage paraṃ saubhāgyam āpnuyāt

lines: From all around own body, twelve-end, mind-dissolving:
firm-minded made firm — the reality-mark proceeds.
sanskrit_cite: sarvataḥ svaśarīrasya dvādaśānte manolayāt | dṛḍhabuddher dṛḍhībhūtaṃ tattvalakṣyam pravartate
